q: How does a Jalandhar sports goods maker work out carbon per ball?
title: Jalandhar sports goods: carbon per ball
short: Divide the unit's electricity and fuel emissions for the month by balls made, for the making stage. Synthetic leather, bladders, thread and packaging bought in are Scope 3 and should come from supplier figures or a named database, labelled with their source.
audience: Sports goods makers in the Jalandhar cluster of Punjab supplying overseas brands

p: Electricity kWh x 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh.
Generator diesel in litres x 2.68 kg CO2 per litre.
Divide by balls made, or by machine hours if products differ.
For most stitched balls, purchased materials outweigh assembly. Ask suppliers for figures per kg and keep the source next to each line.
